comment: Hand-maintained source of truth for published firmware. Each entry points at a LOCAL bin; scripts/build-firmware-catalog.mjs hashes it and emits the signed firmware.json the Console consumes. kind: 'flash' = merged USB image (0x0), 'ota' = app image for /obx/ota. Keep only the versions you want offered — old releases stay downloadable from their versioned GitHub Releases.

firmware.notes: Merged image for first-time USB flashing
Wi-Fi OTA update image. Renames the NVS config namespace — the deck starts from built-in defaults and the Console re-pushes your config on the next connect.
